meta.name: elevenlabs-voice-isolator
meta.description: ElevenLabs voice isolator - remove background noise and isolate vocals from audio via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: noise removal, voice extraction, audio cleanup, background removal. Use for: podcast cleanup, interview audio, music vocals, noisy recordings, audio restoration. Triggers: voice isolator, noise removal, background removal, isolate voice, clean audio, remove background noise, audio cleanup, voice extraction, elevenlabs isolator, eleven labs noise, vocal isolation, denoise, audio restoration, voice separation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除音频背景噪音，提取纯净人声
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理录音中的噪音或提取人声
copy.tagline_en: Remove background noise and isolate vocals from audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean noisy recordings or extract vocals

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你去除音频中的背景噪音，提取纯净的人声。它支持 WAV、MP3 等常见格式，最大处理 500MB、1 小时的音频。
howto.when: 当你需要清理播客、采访、音乐等音频中的环境噪音、背景音乐或回声时触发。

say.text: 帮我去掉这段播客录音的背景噪音。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具处理音频链接。
Claude 会分离人声和伴奏。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can remove background noise from audio and isolate clean vocals. It supports WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC formats up to 500MB and 1 hour.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to clean up noisy recordings like podcasts, interviews, or music by removing ambient noise, background music, or echo.

say_en.text: Clean up the background noise from this podcast recording.
say_en.note: Claude will process the audio link.

say_en.text: Extract the vocals from this song.
say_en.note: Claude will separate vocals from instrumental.
